facts.text: John decided to run for office again last week, despite not having been successful before.

evidence.quote: Last week, I decided to run for office again - even though I haven't been successful before.

facts.text: John expressed that his dream to make a difference in his community is still alive and he feels it is a dream come true.

evidence.quote: I guess I can't let go of my dream to make a difference in my community. Can you believe it? Feels like a dream come true!

facts.text: Maria expressed pride in John for sticking with his dream and believes his drive will pay off.

evidence.quote: I'm so proud of you for sticking with it. You're always dreaming up ways to make a difference and I'm sure your drive will pay off.

facts.text: Maria encouraged John to take risks and stated she is 100% behind him.

evidence.quote: Don't be afraid to take risks-- I'm 100% behind you!
